description: This file implements a class 'ModeSet' for managing DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) display modes, including device initialization, buffer creation, surface management, and page flipping for Raspberry Pi 4. It interacts with DRM, GBM, and related libraries to set up and control display output.

classes.name: ModeSet
classes.description: A class managing DRM mode setting, buffer creation, and page flipping on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the current buffer.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the current buffer.

methods.name: CreateRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates a GBM surface for rendering.

methods.name: AddSurfaceToOutput
methods.description: Adds a GBM surface buffer to DRM output and returns its framebuffer ID.

methods.name: DropSurfaceFromOutput
methods.description: Removes a framebuffer from DRM output.

methods.name: ScanOutRenderTarget
methods.description: Performs page flip to display the render target.
